subject: it's time
body:
the countdown is done. create the token on Coinbin: Create token, ticker COPE, total supply 1,000,000,000. the contract address is reserved to your wallet, Coinbin does the rest.

the listing fee is 15 DOLR. i'll make it up to you in COPE.

it trades from tomorrow. today it's just us.
